area: Portway and West Ham Park (Lodge, Rifle Range, Drill Hall, The Cedars) south to Harberson Road, Park Road / Stork Road, Plaistow Grove, Victoria Cottages, Ann Street
method: Independent second read (QC). All 9 sweep crops viewed and anchored at the moment of opening (r0c0 Urinal/Division of Parly. Boro.; r0c1 Lodge/Rifle Range/D.F.; r0c2 Drill Hall/The Cedars; r1c0 RICHFORD/LIDDINGTON/HARBERSON ROAD; r1c1 open plot with R O A D; r1c2 T R O A D/P.O.; r2c0 VICTORIA COTTAGES/ANN STREET/ALMA TERRACE; r2c1 P A R K/S T O R K; r2c2 W E S T/P A R K R O). Contact sheets and views cs1-cs10, v1, v1b, v2 and marker sheets mkA-mkD (8-14x, plus nearest/bicubic for B.M.28·34) all displayed; every value confirmed at 8x or more, bench-mark decimals at 12x. No other reader file consulted.
legibility: Clean print; no missing tiles. Many dots are interpuncts (P·A·R·K, HARBERSON R·B) or the Portway dash-dot Parly. Boro. & Ward boundary, so many street figures are medium. No sheet join seen by eye or by the sheet tool.
